findings.detail: The E07 source count of 283 combines the 143 current-period positions with 140 comparative-period positions; the output count of 143 is the current schedule only.

rationale: Raw source contains two complete investment schedules: the March 31, 2026 schedule in tables 10-22 and the December 31, 2025 comparative schedule in tables 28-39. The 283 source count equals 143 current positions plus 140 comparative positions. The extracted output has 143 positions and its fair value of 1,495.157 million exactly matches the current-period filing total at table 22 row 2. The distinct comparative total at table 39 row 2 confirms that the second schedule is not part of the report-date population. E07 therefore counted both periods on the source side; the output is complete for the requested report date.
